contract: One canonical recorded payload per DISTINCT moment value declared by docs/fleet-capability-matrix.json (13 launcher verbs + 3 hermes callbacks + 2 explicit moments = 18; none excluded). T-04/T-08 assert local vs remote envelope equality against these same payloads. Values are deterministic (fixed session id suffix 0280, fixed namespace, fixed paths) so the SEED RECIPE is reproducible on every machine; the rendered envelopes are NOT byte-identical across two independently seeded stores, because row ids are minted uuid4 at write time (storelib/write.py:1427) and rendered into the envelope header — assert equality modulo the volatile row id (see README).
provenance_policy: Every payload is AUTHORED AGAINST a named, real contract artifact, not harvested from it: the cited file:line is the shape authority the payload was written to match. The one launcher fixture that carries real recorded fields (tests/fixtures/launcher/claude/input.json) is cited where its fields apply; the remaining launcher shapes are authored against the payload constructors in tests/test_launcher.js and the field reads in hooks/zmem-launch.js. No payload claims to be a recording of a live session.
